summary.text: Lee Hawkins was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2013 and represents House District 27; he chairs the House Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Gainesville, Georgia, earned his D.D.S. degree at Emory University School of Dentistry, and practices dentistry in Gainesville with his son.
Hawkins served in the Georgia State Senate from 2007 to 2010 and was president of the Georgia Dental Association in 2003.
